    offered_wage NUMERIC,
    prevailing_wage NUMERIC,
    offered_unit TEXT,

) RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$

    (
        (CASE WHEN offered_unit = 'Hour' THEN offered_wage * 2080

              WHEN offered_unit = 'Month' THEN offered_wage * 12

        (CASE WHEN prevailing_unit = 'Hour' THEN prevailing_wage * 2080
              WHEN prevailing_unit = 'Week' THEN prevailing_wage * 52
              WHEN prevailing_unit = 'Month' THEN prevailing_wage * 12
              ELSE prevailing_wage END), 0
    ) * 100
AS NUMERIC), 2);
$$ LANGUAGE sql;
